title: The Acropolis
subtitle: Standing above Athens, where the ancient world suddenly felt very close.
summary: There are places you recognize immediately, even before you have ever stood there. The Acropolis was one of those places for us. But photographs could not prepare us for the scale of the hill, the brightness of the marble, or the feeling of looking across a city shaped by thousands of years of history.
heroImageAlt: The Parthenon rising above Athens at the Acropolis
homepageSummary: Stand above Athens among the monuments that shaped the ancient world.

sections.heading: The Climb Above Athens
paragraphs: As we made our way upward, modern Athens gradually disappeared behind us. The streets, traffic and tightly packed buildings gave way to stone pathways, open sky and widening views across the city.

Then the columns of the Parthenon came into view. It was familiar, but seeing it in person gave it an entirely different weight. This was no longer an image from a history book. We were standing inside a place that had endured for centuries.
sections.imageAlt: Wide view of the Parthenon at the Acropolis
sections.imageCaption: The Parthenon emerging above the ancient pathways

sections.heading: More Than the Parthenon
paragraphs: The Parthenon commands attention, but the Acropolis is more than a single structure. The Erechtheion, the Caryatids, the Temple of Athena Nike and the monumental entrance through the Propylaea each add another layer to the story.

What stayed with us most was the contrast: fragile stone against an enormous sky, ancient ruins above a living modern city, and the sense that every generation has viewed this hill through a different moment in history.
sections.imageAlt: The Caryatids supporting the porch of the Erechtheion

sections.heading: A View Across Time
paragraphs: From the top, Athens stretches in every direction. The city seems almost endless, yet the Acropolis remains its unmistakable center.
Standing there, it was easy to understand why this hill has represented Athens for so long. It is not simply above the city geographically. It remains above it symbolically as well.

highlights.title: The Parthenon
highlights.description: The defining structure of the Acropolis and one of the most influential buildings in Western architecture.

highlights.title: The Erechtheion
highlights.description: A graceful temple best known for the Porch of the Caryatids and its six sculpted female figures.

highlights.title: The Propylaea
highlights.description: The monumental gateway that transforms the final approach into a dramatic entrance.

highlights.title: The View of Athens
highlights.description: A sweeping panorama that reveals how completely the ancient citadel still dominates the modern city.

tips.title: Arrive early
tips.description: Earlier entry generally means cooler temperatures, softer light and fewer people on the narrow pathways.

tips.title: Wear shoes with grip
tips.description: The polished marble can be surprisingly slippery, especially on sloped sections.

tips.title: Bring water
tips.description: The site is highly exposed, and shade is limited during the warmest parts of the day.

tips.title: Use a guide
tips.description: The ruins become far more meaningful when their history, architecture and symbolism are explained.
